1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要将比赛仓`external/bk_avdk_smp/`中的权威覆盖文件同步到
16: `bk_avdk_smp`。完整文件清单、可直接执行的同步脚本、逐字节校验、OpenVela AP
17: 构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。Git协作和
18: 提交规则见`github开发指南.md`。
19: 
20: ## UART0控制台使用
21: 
22: 连接开发板UART0：
23: 
24: ```bash
25: picocom --no-escape -b 115200 --flow n --parity n --databits 8 /dev/ttyUSB0
26: ```
27: 
28: CP启动后可先查看AP链路状态，再进入AP的OpenVela NSH控制台：
29: 
30: ```text
31: ap_console status
32: ap_console open
33: ```
34: 
35: 进入AP控制台后可以直接执行NSH命令，例如：
36: 
37: ```text
38: help
39: uname -a
40: ps
41: free
42: ctrlc_test
43: ```
44: 
45: `ctrlc_test`会持续等待TTY `SIGINT`。按`Ctrl-C`后应打印
46: `ctrlc_test received SIGINT`并返回NSH提示符。
47: 
48: AP控制台支持方向键、Home、End、Delete、Backspace、命令历史，以及
49: `Ctrl-A`、`Ctrl-B`、`Ctrl-D`、`Ctrl-E`、`Ctrl-F`、`Ctrl-H`、`Ctrl-K`、
50: `Ctrl-L`、`Ctrl-N`、`Ctrl-P`和`Ctrl-U`等CLE快捷键。
51: 
52: 退出AP控制台并返回CP命令行时，严格按以下顺序操作：
53: 
54: 1. 按下`Ctrl-]`。
55: 2. 松开按键。
56: 3. 再按`.`。
57: 
58: 返回CP命令行后可再次检查状态：
59: 
60: ```text
61: ap_console status
62: ```
63: 
64: ## 主要目录
65: 
66: ```text
67: board/beken/chips/bk7258/                  BK7258 AP启动、中断、定时器和Mailbox驱动
68: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/       BK7258 AP板级配置、链接脚本和bring-up
69: external/bk_avdk_smp/                      已验证的博通CP覆盖文件
70: logs/                                      AI Coding日志
71: ```
72: 
73: ## 已实现功能
74: 
75: - BK7258物理CPU1/AP启动OpenVela/NuttX。
76: - Cortex-M33启动向量、C运行时、MPU、FPU、IRQ和SysTick基础适配。
77: - Mailbox v2基础传输、logical channel、sequence、ACK、超时和FIFO full恢复。
78: - 原厂兼容HW_CTRL command 1 power-up、command 2两秒heartbeat，以及独立的PWC `0x5/0x11`生命周期握手。
79: - AP日志通过Mailbox UART0转发到CP物理UART0。
80: - GPIO40红灯和GPIO41绿灯由NuttX内核自动LED状态接口接管，用于显示
81:   中断、信号、断言、Panic、空闲和启动状态。
82: - AP、CP和Bootloader通过`bk_avdk_smp`标准打包流程生成`all-app.bin`。
83: - 当前为物理CPU1+CPU2的OpenVela/NuttX SMP，CP保持物理CPU0。
84:

87: # contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
88: 
89: 👋 欢迎参加 **2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛**！
90: 
91: 这是组委会为你的队伍创建的**专属参赛仓库**（本仓为样例/模板，队伍编号 `264`；你看到的将是你自己的 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>`）。比赛期间，你的全部参赛代码、打包产物与 AI Coding 日志都提交到这里。

94: 
95: ---
96: 
97: ## 一、先读这些官方文档

100: 
101: | 文档                                                                                                                                     | 用途                                           |
102: | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |

104: | [《参赛代码提交指南》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/code_submission_guide.md)           | 仓库获取、提交流程、时间与权限（**以此为准**） |
105: | [《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_coding_log_guide.md) | 如何导出 AI 对话日志并提交到 `logs/`           |
106: 
107: **按你的赛道选读（三选一）：**
108: 
109: | 赛道                  | 教程导航                                                                                                                                                 |
110: | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
111: | 快应用 / 手表应用创新 | [快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)                         |
112: | AI 硬件产品创新       | [AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)              |
113: | 新硬件适配            | [新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md) |
114: 
115: ---
116: 
117: ## 二、第一步：拉取完整工程
118: 
119: 用组委会提供的命令一键拉取「openvela 全量源码 + 你的专属仓」：
120: 
121: ```bash
122: repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing \
123:   -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing.xml
124: repo sync -c -j8
125: ```
126: 
127: 同步后，你的整个仓库位于工作区的 `contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/`，openvela 全量源码在外层（`nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/`、`vendor/` 等）。
128: 
129: ---
130: 
131: ## 三、第二步：在哪里写代码
132: 
133: **只在自己的仓目录 `contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/` 里开发。** 不同作品形态放在对应子目录，manifest 会通过 `<linkfile>` 把它们**软链**到 openvela 编译树该在的位置——你不用手动 copy：
134: 
135: | 作品形态 | 你的代码放这里             | 系统自动映射到                                 |
136: | -------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
137: | 应用     | `app/hello_app/`           | `packages/demos/contest2026_264_hello_app`     |
138: | 快应用   | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_264_hello_quickapp` |
139: | 板级适配 | `board/contest_board/`     | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_264_board` |
140: 
141: > 用不到的形态目录可以删掉；新增作品时按同样规则加子目录，并在 `contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing.xml` 里补一条 `<linkfile>` 映射即可。**生产仓库（packages/nuttx/vendor 等）零改动。**
142: 
143: 建议仓库目录约定（便于评委定位）：
144: 
145: ```text
146: app/ | quickapp/ | board/   # 你的作品代码
147: logs/                       # AI Coding 日志（主动导出后提交，格式见 logs/README.md）
148: README.md                   # 作品说明（提交前请改成你自己的，见第六节）
149: ```
150: 
151: > 仓内附带了一个 `.gitignore.example`，给出了**编译产物**等不需要进仓的文件示例。如需启用，`cp .gitignore.example .gitignore` 后按需增删即可。**注意 `logs/` 下最终导出的 AI Coding 日志必须提交，不要忽略。**
152: >
153: > `logs/` 的目录结构与提交格式见 [logs/README.md](logs/README.md)。

155: ---
156: 
157: ## 四、第三步：编译与运行
158: 
159: 编译/运行步骤随作品形态不同而不同，请参考你所在赛道的教程导航：
160: 
161: - 快应用 / 手表应用：[快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)（含模拟器与开发板部署）。
162: - AI 硬件产品创新：[AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)（环境搭建、编译烧录、Skill 开发）。
163: - 新硬件适配：[新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md)（BSP 移植、最小 NSH 基线）。
164: 
165: 子目录已通过 manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 软链进 openvela 编译树，因此构建在 openvela 工作区**根目录**（即你这个仓的上一级）进行。openvela 使用 `build.sh` 作为统一入口，接收一个 **board config 路径**作为参数：
166: 
167: ```bash
168: # 进入 openvela 工作区根目录（你的仓的上一级）
169: cd ..
170: 
171: # 通用语法：第一个参数是 board config 路径，第二个参数可以是 menuconfig / distclean 等
172: ./build.sh <board-config-path> [menuconfig|distclean] [-j8]
173: ```
174: 
175: > 具体的 board config 路径、目标产物、模拟器/真机部署方式请以你所在赛道的教程导航为准。本仓 `app/` `quickapp/` `board/` 三个示例骨架对应的 Kconfig 选项可通过 `menuconfig` 启用。
176: 
177: ---
178: 
179: ## 五、第四步：提交作品
180: 
181: 1. **fork** 你的专属仓 → 开发 → `git commit` 并推送 → 向专属仓发起 **Pull Request**，可**自行 review 并合入**（无需等组委会）。

183: 3. 若需改动 **nuttx 等公共仓库**，不在本仓改，而是 fork 对应公共仓、以 PR 提交到 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支，由组委会 review 后合入。

185: > ⏰ **提交作品截止：9 月 20 日**。截止后统一收回 push 权限，仍可查看 / clone。

187: > 获奖后再按要求将作品 PR 至 openvela 上游对应仓库（走标准 PR + CI 流程）。

190:

194: ---
195:

197: 
198: 本文件目前是组委会给的**使用说明书**。**作品提交前，请把它替换成你自己作品的说明**，方便评委快速了解你做了什么、怎么跑起来。建议至少包含以下内容：

323: ## 4. 正式启动时序
324: 
325: ### 4.1 CPU0/CP阶段
326: 
327: CP保持原代码，不改变 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：
328: 
329: 1. Bootloader/CP完成CPU0启动。
330: 2. CP初始化系统时钟、电源管理、UART0、CPU0侧mailbox和必要共享资源。
331: 3. CP按 `PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP`投票打开CPU1。
332: 4. CP清除CPU1 power-down。
333: 5. CP将AP逻辑起始地址写入CPU1 boot offset寄存器。写入值为 `boot_address >> 8`。
334: 6. CP选择CPU1 RXEVT路径，释放CPU1 software reset。
335: 7. CP启动CPU1后存在两套独立等待：原厂IPC heartbeat任务每次最多等待2秒接收HW_CTRL power-up indication，最多打印到`retry_cnt:4`；OpenVela boot transaction在当前实现中给AP 10秒完成UART link、HW_CTRL cmd1和PWC `0x5` milestone，失败保留诊断并rollback。
336: 
337: 代码依据：
338: 
339: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
340: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
341: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:203-220`
342: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`

344: ### 4.2 CPU1/openvela阶段
345: 
346: CPU1 reset handler必须严格按以下顺序执行：
347: 
348: ```text
349: CPU1 boot vector
350:   1. 关闭异常和外部中断
351:   2. 使用 boot vector 提供的 MSP
352:   3. 设置 MSPLIM/栈边界
353:   4. 设置 CPU1 固定身份，不写 CPU0 身份
354:   5. 初始化 Secure CM33 基础状态
355:   6. 设置 CP10/CP11，建立 hard-float运行环境
356:   7. 初始化必要的 TCM/系统 fault 状态
357:   8. 复制 .data 和 runtime vector；首版禁止可执行 .ramfunc
358:   9. 清零 AP 私有 .bss
359:  10. 初始化 MPU
360:  11. 设置 VTOR 到 RAM runtime vector
361:  12. DSB; ISB
362:   13. 仅完成必要的低级Mailbox准备；不调用NuttX IRQ/同步API
363:  14. 调用 nx_start()，不得返回
364:       -> hardware_initialize()
365:          -> irq_initialize()调用BK up_irqinitialize()
366:          -> clock_initialize()调用SysTick lower-half
367:          -> up_initialize()/early serial注册Mailbox UART console并启动physical MBOX IRQ79
368:       -> nx_bringup()/board late
369:           -> 启动Mailbox和Mailbox UART workers并完成STATE link
370:           -> 启动CPU1->CPU0 HW_CTRL power-up和2秒heartbeat服务
371:           -> 创建PM worker并等待worker_ready握手
372:           -> open MB_CHNL_PWC
373:           -> 发送一次 PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD(1, 0, 0)
374: ```
375: 
376: 这个顺序的依据是：
377: 
378: - C代码调用前必须先完成SP、C runtime和FPU状态。
379: - MPU必须在NuttX访问heap和外设前建立，但runtime vector复制必须在MPU限制生效前完成或放在允许区域。
380: - VTOR必须在NVIC开启前切换，避免中断进入错误向量。
381: - reset阶段不能调用 `irq_attach()`、NuttX spinlock/semaphore或创建worker，因为 `irq_initialize()`、memory和scheduler尚未完成。mailbox必须在 `up_initialize()` 后具备完整RX/ACK能力；PWC复杂动作由PM worker执行，因为CP可能在ready后立即发送命令。
382: - 不得在 `nx_start()`返回后手工调用 `irq_initialize()`、`clock_initialize()`或 `up_initialize()`；这些步骤是上面展示的内部调用链，`nx_start()`正常情况下不返回。
383: - `nx_start()`会初始化NuttX的任务、IRQ、clock和硬件，并最终创建应用启动流程，见 `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-826`。

385: ready的正式含义是：CPU1已经具备持续运行、响应CP IPC/PWC命令并发送heartbeat的能力，不表示NSH或所有应用已启动。CPU1必须先发送兼容Armino的IPC power-up indication；ready发送必须在NuttX调度器、Mailbox RX路径、IPC heartbeat和PM worker具备后执行，禁止只发送一个裸ready消息。

389: 进入 `nx_start()`后的调用顺序：

391: ```text
392: nx_start()
393:   -> tasklist_initialize()
394:   -> memory_initialize()
395:   -> hardware_initialize()
396:        -> irq_initialize()
397:        -> clock_initialize()
398:        -> up_initialize()
399:        -> drivers_initialize()
400:        -> board_early_initialize()
401:   -> nx_bringup()
402:        -> board_late_initialize()
403:        -> nsh_main()

408: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:757-826`
409: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_bringup.c:293-501`

411: BK特有的CPU1身份、MPU和vector属于reset阶段；NuttX IRQ注册、UART正式设备和mailbox transport正式目标属于 `up_initialize()`；PM worker、PWC命令语义和ready发送属于board bring-up。UART不在board late重复注册。这样既符合NuttX生命周期，也保证ready发出时调度器和RX路径已可用。

415: ## 5. 双向量镜像设计
416: 
417: ### 5.1 必须保留Flash boot vector
418: 
419: CPU1 boot address直接指向AP镜像起点，因此镜像offset 0必须是有效的 Cortex-M vector：
420: 
421: - word 0：AP RAM范围内的初始MSP。
422: - word 1：位于AP Flash的Thumb reset handler地址；仅凭该值不能证明Secure state。

439: .vectors
440:   LMA: Flash

519: ### 6.1 Kconfig和工具链

521: 芯片Kconfig必须选择：

535: 
536: ```make
537: include armv8-m/Make.defs
538: ```
539: 
540: 必须使用与原AP一致的CPU属性：
541: 
542: ```text
543: -mcpu=cortex-m33+nodsp
544: -mthumb
545: -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16

547: -mcmse

552: ### 6.2 Reset/C runtime
553: 
554: `bk7258_start.c`必须实现：
555: 
556: - `__start()`。
557: - `_sbss/_ebss`清零。
558: - `_eronly -> _sdata/_edata`复制。
559: - 首版拒绝 `.ramfunc` alloc section；确需执行时再单独增加可执行MPU override和复制符号。
560: - runtime vector复制和VTOR切换。
561: - CPU1 Secure基础状态和FPU状态。
562: - MPU初始化。
563: - 调用 `nx_start()`且不得返回。
564: 
565: 不能直接链接原FreeRTOS CMSIS startup，因为它会定义另一套 Reset、SVC、PendSV、SysTick和 `_start`：
566: 
567: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:360-400`
568: 
569: 应复用其硬件事实，例如VTOR、TCM、FPU和MSPLIM的设置方式，但由openvela芯片层重新组织调用顺序。
570: 
571: ### 6.3 IRQ
572: 
573: BK7258 AP IRQ表来源：
574: 
575: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:28-94`
576: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/bk7258_ap/interrupt.c:114-245`
577: 
578: 已确认的外部NVIC line：
579: 
580: | 外设 | 外部line | NuttX IRQ |
581: | --- | ---: | ---: |
582: | TIMER0 | 3 | 19 |
583: | UART0 | 4 | 20 |
584: | TIMER1 | 13 | 29 |
585: | UART1 | 15 | 31 |
586: | UART2 | 16 | 32 |
587: | MAILBOX统一ICU source | 63 | 79 |
588: 
589: openvela `bk7258_irq.c`实现：
590: 
591: - `up_irqinitialize()`：关闭所有外部IRQ、设置VTOR、配置默认priority、绑定SVC/HardFault/BusFault/UsageFault/MemFault/SecureFault、最后开启中断。
592: - `up_enable_irq()`：按NVIC ISER或系统异常寄存器开启。
593: - `up_disable_irq()`：按NVIC ICER或系统异常寄存器关闭。
594: - `up_prioritize_irq()`：按NVIC优先级寄存器设置。
595: - `arm_ack_irq()`：NVIC无需单独ack，外设ISR负责清设备pending。
596: 
597: BK7258外部中断不是只配置NVIC即可，必须实现完整三级路径：
598: 
599: ```text
600: 外设中断源
601:   -> 系统控制层将source路由到物理CPU1或CPU2
602:   -> 目标core私有NVIC external line
603:   -> NuttX IRQ编号和ISR
604: ```
605: 
606: 例如mailbox必须完成`source 63 -> CPU1系统路由 -> NVIC line 63 -> NuttX IRQ 79`。只在`irq.h`定义编号不能使中断到达CPU1。进入SMP阶段后，每个外设还必须明确唯一owner或共享路由策略，不能让CPU1和CPU2同时无保护处理同一外设中断；AP日志使用Mailbox UART逻辑通道，不要求CPU1接管物理UART1中断。
607: 
608: 必须在 `include/irq.h` 固化两个编号域，例如 `BK7258_EXTIRQ_MAILBOX=63`、`BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX=BK7258_IRQ_FIRST+63=79`，并设置 `NR_IRQS=80`。`irq_attach()`使用79，NVIC bit和BK gate使用63。`IRQ_MAILBOX0=48`、`IRQ_MAILBOX1=49`等旧header注释不能代替CPU1最终映射。
609: 
610: 还必须区分两套“group”命名：`icu_map.h`中的逻辑group与系统寄存器0-31/32-63 enable bank不是同一概念。mailbox driver实际对source 63调用 `sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(..., 1 << (63 - 32))`，即打开32-63 bank的bit31。文档和实现均应使用“32-63 bank”描述寄存器，避免写成含糊的GROUP1。
611: 
612: ### 6.4 Timer
613: 
614: 系统tick固定使用 Cortex-M SysTick：
615: 
616: - `CONFIG_TIMER=y`
617: - `CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y`
618: - `CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000`
619: - `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS`关闭
620: 
621: 优先复用openvela ARMv8-M SysTick lower-half，而不是自写旧式ISR直接调用 `nxsched_process_timer()`：
622: 
623: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_timerisr.c`
624: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Kconfig`
625: 
626: `up_timer_initialize()`调用 `systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1)`，再调用 `up_timer_set_lowerhalf()`。
627: 
628: 首版固定CPU1频率，不支持runtime DVFS，直到确认CP通知发生在频率切换前还是后、SysTick时钟源及时间补偿协议。仅暂停并重装reload会丢tick，不能作为正式DVFS实现。后续必须设计pre-change/post-change握手、临界区更新和已流逝时间补偿测试后再启用。
629: 
630: 不把BK TIMER0同时用于系统tick，避免与CP和外设共享同一timer资源。
631: 
632: ### 6.5 AP日志转发到CP UART0
633: 
634: 正式物理日志口使用CP UART0。AP日志目标路径是Mailbox虚拟UART转发到CP，由CP侧UART0统一输出；当前已实现基础日志转发，完整压力验证和reset恢复仍有缺口：
635: 
636: - AP通过Mailbox UART逻辑通道向CP发送日志数据。
637: - CP接收后通过UART0输出到开发板的物理日志口。
638: - CP UART0：115200 8N1。
639: - CPU1不接管GPIO0/1，不启用UART1作为AP console。
640: 
641: UART0是板上的物理日志口：BK7258 UART0 TX/RX 经 CH340 USB转串口芯片接到 Type-C 接口，PC 端通过 Type-C 枚举出 CH340 串口设备接收日志。因此 CP 的所有 log、AP 经Mailbox转发的 log，以及烧录工具的下载通信，都通过这条 UART0->CH340->Type-C->PC 物理链路完成。OpenVela AP不建立独立的UART1控制台。
642: 
643: 地址和GPIO映射见：
644: 
645: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:26-40`
646: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:169-179`
647: 
648: 当前 `app_ab` AP GPIO配置把GPIO0/1作为I2C1，见：
649: 
650: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:22-25`
651: 
652: 正式OpenVela board配置不应接管GPIO0/1为UART1，保留CP侧UART0和现有AP GPIO资源配置。CP GPIO配置不修改。
653: 
654: 芯片层实现：

656: - `bk7258_lowputc.c`：早期bring-up使用UART1 polling；当前正式日志路径已切换到Mailbox UART转发，UART1临时路径应已禁用或删除。
657: - `bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`：承载Mailbox逻辑命令和PWC；Mailbox UART日志转发基础已实现，完整流控、压力和reset恢复仍有缺口。
658: - AP侧日志转发不得阻塞Mailbox中断，也不能在中断上下文执行复杂格式化。
659: - CP侧使用现有UART0 log driver输出到物理串口；AP不注册物理UART1 console。
660: 
661: AP控制台目标必须依赖CPU0 mailbox日志转发，因为网页文档规定BK7258 AP日志通过Mailbox发送到CP，再由CP侧日志串口输出。ready之前的启动故障日志暂不能承诺可见；不能另行切换到UART1作为正式路径。
662: 
663: 官方AP日志路径通过Mailbox转发到CP的UART0。控制台只保留一条正式路径：AP日志经Mailbox虚拟UART发送，CP通过UART0输出。必须区分Mailbox虚拟UART和CPU1物理UART1，不能把二者混用。
664: 
665: #### 6.5.1 本轮方案：仅使用开发板UART0
666: 
667: 本轮开发板只有一条可连接电脑的物理串口，因此暂不使用CPU1物理UART1。正式调试路径固定为：
668: 
669: ```text
670: OpenVela CPU1
671:   -> AP syslog/console backend
672:   -> Mailbox UART logical channel
673:   -> MBOX0 shared buffer and ACK
674:   -> CP Mailbox UART receiver
675:   -> CP UART0 log/output driver
676:   -> GPIO11/UART0_TX
677:   -> CH340/USB Type-C/PC
678: ```
679: 
680: UART1在本方案中不是备用控制台，而是明确禁用的临时bring-up路径：
681: 
682: - 不把GPIO0/1切换为UART1。
683: - 不注册物理UART1为`/dev/console`。
684: - 不要求第二个USB-TTL或额外串口设备。
685: - AP的NSH标准输入、标准输出和标准错误均通过Mailbox虚拟UART连接到CP UART0。
686: - CP原有UART0日志、CP Shell和AP转发日志共享同一物理输出路径；输出必须保持可区分的`ap0`前缀，避免把AP日志误认为CP日志。
687: 
688: #### 6.5.2 参考协议和通道选择
689: 
690: 实现前必须从Armino源代码确认以下内容，禁止仅根据`MB_CHNL_LOG`名称自行定义新协议：
691: 
692: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mb_uart/`或对应`mb_uart_driver.c`的实际路径、逻辑通道和消息结构。
693: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_uart.h`及相关类型、状态码和回调语义。
694: - CP侧对应的Mailbox UART接收、发送和UART0输出实现。
695: - `博通网页文档/多核通讯-Uart通讯接口 — 博通集成 ARMINO SMP开发框架 文档.html`中`MB_UART0`的初始化、读写、TX/RX回调和溢出语义。
696: - AP/CP两侧的共享buffer位置、长度、32字节对齐要求、缓存属性和buffer所有权。
697: 
698: 优先复用Armino已有的`MB_UART0`作为AP到CP的日志输出通道。只有在源码交叉验证确认`MB_UART0`不是CPU1到CPU0日志方向时，才选择对应的日志逻辑通道；不能把IPC `0x10`或PWC通道复用于日志。
699: 
700: #### 6.5.3 AP侧分层设计
701: 
702: AP侧应拆成三个层次，避免在syslog路径直接操作MBOX寄存器：
703: 
704: 1. **Mailbox UART transport**：负责标准logical channel、共享buffer、sequence、transport ACK、FIFO full、reset和错误计数。
705: 2. **NuttX serial/syslog backend**：将`/dev/console`、`/dev/ttyS0`或等价的NuttX console设备映射到Mailbox UART虚拟设备；具体设备名以NuttX配置和驱动注册方式为准，不预先假定`ttyS0`。
706: 3. **NSH和syslog使用层**：让`nsh_main`使用同一虚拟console，syslog输出复用同一路径；禁止为NSH另建UART1物理后端。
707: 
708: 日志数据路径要求：
709: 
710: - 普通日志在任务上下文写入有界环形TX队列，由Mailbox UART worker异步发送。
711: - Mailbox ISR只完成FIFO drain、消息校验、transport ACK和事件投递，不格式化日志、不等待semaphore、不执行文件系统操作。
712: - TX队列满时采用明确策略：普通日志丢弃并累计计数；错误日志优先但仍受有界队列和单条最大长度限制；不能无限阻塞影响heartbeat和系统启动。
713: - 日志消息必须支持换行、连续短消息合并和单条消息分片；分片不得破坏消息边界或复用仍处于in-flight状态的共享buffer。
714: - AP启动早期在NuttX mailbox transport正式可用前，不承诺完整日志转发；如保留最小故障路径，必须是有界、无阻塞、不会接管GPIO0/1的机制。
715: - AP日志应由CP侧统一添加或保留`ap0`来源标识，并禁止在AP和CP两侧重复添加前缀。
716: 
717: #### 6.5.4 CP侧接收和UART0输出
718: 
719: CP侧保持原有UART0硬件和GPIO配置，不修改`projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/usr_gpio_cfg.h`。Mailbox UART接收服务应：
720: 
721: - 在Mailbox接收路径完成source、destination、长度、对齐、地址窗口和sequence校验。
722: - 对有效日志完成transport ACK后，将数据投递到CP日志输出队列；不在Mailbox ISR中直接阻塞写UART0。
723: - 由CP日志任务按原有UART0驱动输出，保持115200 8N1和现有CP Shell行为。
724: - 正确处理AP重启、旧消息、重复ACK、FIFO full和reset重同步，避免旧AP日志污染新一轮启动。
725: - 对AP日志转发失败保留计数和最后错误原因；诊断信息不能反过来依赖同一条已经失效的Mailbox日志通道。
726: 
727: #### 6.5.5 启动时序和ready约束
728: 
729: 日志转发服务不能改变CPU1启动契约：
730: 
731: ```text
732: CPU1 reset
733:   -> NuttX基础启动和UART0-independent console backend准备
734:   -> MBOX0物理层、IRQ79和RX drain可用
735:   -> Mailbox UART logical channel建立
736:   -> AP日志TX队列和worker就绪
737:   -> IPC power-up indication
738:   -> heartbeat worker
739:   -> PWC worker
740:   -> PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD
741:   -> NSH启动并使用Mailbox console
742: ```
743: 
744: 其中`IPC power-up indication`和heartbeat仍使用`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`，Mailbox UART日志不得覆盖、复用或改变这两个IPC command。`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`只能在日志worker、Mailbox RX路径和PWC worker均已可运行后发送，但日志worker失败不能通过无界等待阻塞heartbeat；应记录失败并按预先定义的降级策略继续或停止ready。
745: 
746: #### 6.5.6 分阶段实施和验收
747: 
748: 本轮review通过后按以下顺序实施：
749: 
750: 1. **协议确认**：从Armino AP/CP源码确认MB_UART0方向、channel ID、消息格式、buffer和回调语义，形成AP/CP字段对照表。
751: 2. **只读验证**：先在OpenVela中保留UART1代码但不启用，增加Mailbox UART最小发送测试；测试数据不能接管GPIO0/1。
752: 3. **AP transport**：实现对齐共享buffer、TX队列、分片、ACK、超时、FIFO full和reset状态机。
753: 4. **CP接收桥接**：接入现有CP UART0日志任务，验证CP日志和AP日志并发输出不互相破坏。
754: 5. **NuttX console接入**：将NSH console、syslog和`up_putc`的正式后端切换到Mailbox UART；删除或禁用UART1 console注册和GPIO0/1 pinmux。
755: 6. **启动诊断**：在Mailbox不可用阶段只保留最小故障计数；确认正常启动后AP日志和`nsh>`均能从UART0观察到。
756: 7. **压力验收**：验证连续日志、长行分片、队列满、AP复位、CP复位、Mailbox reset、heartbeat并发和CP Shell输入。
757: 
758: 最低验收日志：
759: 
760: ```text
761: CP UART0: CP boot log
762: CP UART0: ap0: OpenVela early/bringup log
763: CP UART0: ap0: mailbox uart ready
764: CP UART0: nsh>
765: ```
766: 
767: 必须同时满足：
768: 
769: - 只有UART0连接电脑即可完成日志观察和NSH交互。
770: - GPIO0/1没有被OpenVela切换为UART1。
771: - 连续运行期间不出现IPC heartbeat timeout。
772: - 日志压力不能导致Mailbox TX buffer覆盖、PWC卡死或CP UART0异常。

775: ### 6.6 MPU、FPU和cache
776: 
777: 正式配置启用：
778: 
779: ```text
780: CONFIG_ARM_MPU=y
781: CONFIG_ARM_MPU_RESET=y
782: CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y
783: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
784: CONFIG_ARM_DSP is not set
785: ```
786: 
787: MPU region不是原BK宽范围表的原样复制，而是基于其memory attribute重新收紧所有权。region数量必须从MPU `TYPE.DREGION`读回，显式写入 `CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS`并在启动时校验；在TRM或实测前不得写死16，也不能盲目分配超过硬件能力的region。若region不足，首版只保留Flash、AP SRAM、外设和必需共享窗口，PSRAM/QSPI后置。目标策略：
788: 
789: | 区域 | 地址 | 属性 |
790: | --- | --- | --- |
791: | Flash | `0x02000000-0x02ffffff` | Secure RO/X，write-through |
792: | AP instruction alias | `0x08000000-0x0809ffff` | RO/X |
793: | DTCM | `0x20000000-0x20003fff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
794: | AP SRAM | `0x28010000-0x28063fff` | RW/XN，shareable；不得包含CP RAM |
795: | PWR_MNG | `0x2809f700-0x2809f7ff` | RW，Device，shareable |
796: | peripheral | `0x40000000-0x5fffffff` | Device，XN，shareable |
797: | PSRAM | `0x60000000-0x63ffffff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
798: | QSPI0 | `0x64000000-0x67ffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
799: | QSPI1 | `0x68000000-0x6bffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
800: 
801: 参考：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38-149`。原表将SRAM覆盖到 `0x3fffffff`，不能提供AP/CP边界；PWR_MNG若作为AP SRAM region的override，必须明确更高优先级region编号。首版禁止 `.ramfunc`，避免与SRAM整体XN策略矛盾。
802: 
803: FPU从reset阶段启用CP10/CP11，所有对象统一hard-float。NuttX公共层负责线程浮点上下文保存，不能把FPU支持延后到另一个ABI。
804: 
805: I-cache和D-cache在正式第一版保持关闭，因为现有 `mbox0_adapter.c`在发送端没有与接收端对称的D-cache clean/invalidate：
806: 
807: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:15-38`
808: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
809: 
810: 后续若启用D-cache，必须先将mailbox共享buffer放到non-cacheable MPU region，或者为发送、接收和所有权交接实现完整32字节cache line clean/invalidate、DMB和DSB。

876: ### 7.2.1 CPU1 IPC启动握手
877: 
878: CPU0在启动CPU1后不会只等待`PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`。CP侧`mb_ipc_heartbeat.c`先等待CPU1通过`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`发送IPC power-up indication，再接受后续heartbeat；缺少该消息时会出现：
879: 
880: ```text
881: IPC retry to start core1, retry_cnt:N
882: ```
883: 
884: 协议必须保持与Armino `ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.h`一致：
885: 
886: | 消息 | command | 方向 | logical channel | 参数 |
887: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
888: | `IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION` | `1` | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x10` (`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`) | payload地址=`0x2809f900`，长度=0 |
889: | `IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION` | `2` | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x10` (`MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`) | payload地址=`0x2809f900`，长度=4，值=0 |
890: 
891: CPU1在Mailbox transport link ready后必须先发送command 1；heartbeat服务随后每2秒发送command 2。两条消息使用标准16字节logical command结构和原厂SWAP共享buffer envelope，发送端等待最多600 ms transport/semantic ACK并要求`ack_state=ACK_STATE_COMPLETE(2)`。IPC power-up和heartbeat是CPU基础存活契约，不能由PWC ready或PWC自定义command替代。
892: 
893: 当前NuttX配置为`CONFIG_SMP=y`且未启用`CONFIG_BMP`。`DEFINE_PER_CPU_BMP`因此退化为
894: 全局单实例，生成map中的`g_system_ticks`和`g_wdactivelist`各只有一个对象。系统保持
895: logical CPU0唯一SysTick并只在该核调用完整`nxsched_process_timer()`；不得在logical CPU1
896: 重复调用该完整入口，否则会重复推进全局tick、watchdog及RR记账。heartbeat不再使用
897: 未经实板确认的AON RTC counter，而由CPU0-only mailbox TX worker依据全局NuttX tick
898: 建立2秒deadline；command 1之后的第一帧command 2同样等待完整2秒协议周期。
899: 
900: late bring-up线程默认affinity包含两个AP CPU，不能依靠`DEBUGASSERT`保证私有SysTick
901: 寄存器写发生在logical CPU0，也不能在CPU2 exception-return窗口通过setaffinity或SMP call
902: 迁移该线程；实板已证明这会让CPU2停在boottrace secondary stage 10。当前在任何worker
903: 创建和父线程setaffinity之前只读轮询`secondary >= 12`，再让`mbox-v2`从首条指令起继承
904: CPU0-only affinity并直接启动CPU0 SysTick。timer函数运行时再次检查CPU编号，但不发送IPI。
905: cmd1 ACK后的heartbeat enable/deadline由CPU0 mailbox完成回调发布。所有physical CP
906: descriptor仍只能由该CPU0 worker发送。AON RTC alarm、深睡唤醒和从核sleep/RR路径仍属
907: 待实板验证边界，不能写成当前已完成能力。
908: 
909: 当前职责固定为：HW_CTRL command 1触发CP `CORE_STARTING -> CORE_POWER_ON`，command 2刷新原厂heartbeat；PWC `0x5`只表示OpenVela SMP/PWC worker可服务，PWC `0x11`只表示480 MHz、CPU2和PSRAM ownership最终commit或rollback。已废止的PWC `0x12`迁移方案不得恢复。

911: ### 7.2.2 当前mailbox实现的已知缺口
912: 
913: 以下缺口中，部分已在后续开发中修复，部分仍待完善。当前代码尚未达到完整mailbox v2 transport：
914: 
915: 1. **RX指针校验窗口**（已修复）：当前代码已将 CP envelope 校验窗口改为 `0x28064000 <= pointer < 0x2809f700`，覆盖 CP SRAM 范围。Wi-Fi 等子系统的跨核链表逐节点 pointer/length/num 校验仍有缺口，见 `BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md` 第 3.3 节。
916: 
917: 2. **IPC TX生命周期**（已修复）：HW_CTRL、PWC、Wi-Fi和UART均进入同一logical transport；每个channel先复制到pending，单个active transaction持有稳定16字节message直到ACK。HW_CTRL另外用mutex覆盖message准备、发送和等待，4字节heartbeat payload固定在原厂SWAP地址`0x2809f900`，不会与UART `0x2809fc00/0x2809fd00`覆盖。
918: 
919: 3. **Transport ACK消费**（已修复）：当前实现校验channel、sequence、command、control和state，并使用8个稳定ACK slot、timeout和reset epoch。active的busy/order必须在发布physical descriptor前建立，发送失败再回滚，避免CP快速ACK在`bk7258_mbox_send()`返回前被误判为stale。
920: 
921: 4. **worker_ready等待**（已修复）：Mailbox、HW_CTRL heartbeat和PWC worker均检查`kthread_create()`并使用200 ms或1 s有界semaphore handshake；失败返回errno，不再无界`sched_yield()`。
922: 
923: 5. **mailbox IRQ注册时序**（已修复）：early serial阶段完成logical init、physical MBOX IRQ和console注册；board late只启动workers、完成UART STATE link、HW_CTRL liveness和PWC服务。
924: 
925: ### 7.3 PWC方向和命令服务
926: 
927: PWC命令定义：
928: 
929: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
930: 
931: PWC不能按“CPU1收到后执行”统一描述。CP/AP两侧源码表明power/clock/frequency主要是AP向CP请求，由CP执行系统硬件动作并返回；ready由AP发送；PSRAM/recovery存在CP向AP通知。编码前必须为每个命令从两侧调用点生成完整协议表，至少包含request direction、执行主体、3个参数、transport ACK、semantic response、timeout和recovery。已确认的主方向：
932: 
933: | 命令 | 主请求方向 | 执行主体/CPU1职责 |
934: | --- | --- | --- |
935: | `PM_POWER_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行系统电源操作；AP等待并处理响应 |
936: | `PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行主时钟操作；AP处理响应 |
937: | `PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP协调睡眠；AP侧状态机配合 |
938: | `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行频率操作；首版AP固定频率并拒绝未支持的DVFS |
939: | `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` | AP -> CP | AP只发送一次，CP记录ready |
940: | `PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD` | 双向/状态通知 | AP不得重复执行与CP冲突的PHY初始化；按golden职责完成AP静态区域和独立allocator状态管理 |
941: | `PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD` | CP -> AP查询为主 | AP返回受控PSRAM allocator使用量 |
942: | `PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD` | CP -> AP | AP投递worker输出受控分配状态 |
943: | `PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD` | CP -> AP | AP quiesce后返回状态 |
944: | 其他sleep/wakeup/AP状态命令 | 逐调用点确认 | ISR仅ACK/入队，worker执行语义动作 |
945: 
946: 原AP PWC RX handler已给出命令处理边界：
947: 
948: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:288-439`
949: 
950: openvela实现必须保持同样的分层：
951: 
952: ```text
953: mailbox ISR
954:   -> 校验transport和命令
955:   -> 完成必要ACK
956:   -> 投递PWC消息到高优先级PM worker
957:   -> PM worker执行电源/时钟/PSRAM/recovery动作
958:   -> 发送语义响应
959: ```
960: 
961: ISR禁止执行PSRAM初始化、频率切换、文件系统操作、阻塞等待或复杂日志输出。
962: 
963: ### 7.4 WDT、heartbeat和Flash代理
964: 
965: BK7258硬件WDT由CP管理，AP没有可独占的本地硬件watchdog。openvela AP必须实现的是：
966: 
967: - 周期性AP heartbeat，默认协议和超时时间以当前CP实现为准。
968: - 通过mailbox请求CP执行全系统reboot。
969: - heartbeat丢失、mailbox失联和AP recovery的状态处理。
970: - 如向NuttX注册watchdog lower-half，必须明确标记为CP远端代理，不能直接访问WDT寄存器或声称提供独立AP硬件watchdog。
971: 
972: AP对Flash的能力也必须拆分：CPU1可从AP code分区XIP读取和执行，但Flash擦除、编程、配置写入和OTA必须通过CP/mailbox代理。当前OpenVela尚未实现该Flash proxy；后续MTD实现应是mailbox-backed Flash proxy，并至少校验分区白名单、地址溢出、擦除粒度、XIP冲突、超时和断电恢复；不得照搬单核平台的直接Flash controller lower-half。
973: 
974: ### 7.5 Ready时序
975: 
976: ready必须在以下条件全部满足后发送：
977: 
978: - runtime vector已经安装。
979: - MPU已经生效。
980: - MBOX0物理层已经初始化。
981: - CPU1 RX FIFO已清空。
982: - NuttX IRQ79已经注册，NVIC line63和32-63 gate已经使能。
983: - `MB_CHNL_PWC`已经建立等价的RX/ACK状态机；当前代码已实现固定channel分发和基础ACK匹配，generic channel状态机和完整语义响应仍有缺口。
984: - CPU1->CPU0 `MB_CHNL_HW_CTRL`已经建立等价channel状态机，IPC power-up indication已经收到`ack_state=2`的原厂完成ACK。
985: - IPC heartbeat worker已经运行，并按2秒周期发送heartbeat。
986: - NuttX heap、IRQ和clock基础设施已经初始化。
987: - NuttX调度器已运行，PM worker线程已真正执行队列初始化并置位 `worker_ready`，board bring-up以有界等待确认，而不是仅检查 `kthread_create()`成功。
988: - `ready_sent`状态保证同一次boot只发送一次。
989: 
990: ready发送内容固定为：
991: 
992: ```text
993: cmd    = PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD (0x5)
994: param1 = 1
995: param2 = 0
996: param3 = 0
997: ```
998: 
999: CP OpenVela boot transaction当前给AP 10秒等待窗口；IPC power-up仍由原厂heartbeat task按2秒间隔等待并输出retry诊断。两者职责独立：
1000: 
1001: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:341-371`
1002: 
1003: 目标仍是冷启动ready P99小于200 ms，为CP窗口保留足够裕量；这不是CP当前硬编码超时值。该指标尚未完成实板统计，当前只能确认离线构建和代码路径。

1124: ## 10. Board初始化和服务启动
1125: 
1126: ### 10.1 board early
1127: 
1128: AP不配置GPIO0/1到UART1。若需要early polling日志，则在 `bk7258_start.c`/chip early阶段使用受限Mailbox transport；`board_early_initialize()`只执行其后的非阻塞板级动作：
1129: 
1130: - 校验GPIO0/1未被AP错误切换为UART1，不把board early作为首次pinmux点。
1131: - 完成不影响early console的其余板级GPIO配置。
1132: - 必要的CPU1 GPIO状态。
1133: - 不启动USB、Wi-Fi、媒体和CPU2。
1134: 
1135: 不得在此阶段等待semaphore、访问文件系统或启动复杂服务。openvela文档明确early hook位于核心组件完成前：
1136: 
1137: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/device_dev_guide/kernel/boot_process.md:37-45`
1138: 
1139: ### 10.2 board late
1140: 
1141: 正式目标中`board_late_initialize()`应执行：
1142: 
1143: - 启动PWC PM worker并在其可运行后发送CPU1 ready。
1144: - 启动IPC heartbeat和PWC worker；诊断和错误统计线程仍待实现。
1145: - 发送CPU1 ready前确认transport状态。
1146: - NuttX基础设备由公共启动流程初始化，board late只启动板级服务。
1147: 
1148: 当前实现的board late仅调用`bk7258_pwc_start()`，尚未启动Mailbox UART日志转发服务。当前UART1仍在`bk7258_serial.c`注册为`/dev/console`，这是临时bring-up行为，与正式目标不一致。

1150: ### 10.3 board app initialize
1151: 
1152: 正式目标中`board_app_initialize()`应执行：
1153: 
1154: - Mailbox UART console/NSH输入输出验证。
1155: - procfs、ROMFS和NSH依赖初始化。
1156: - 后续启用独立PSRAM allocator，但必须先完成向CP请求上电并收到成功的semantic response。

1158: 不在首版启动任何要求CPU2、Wi-Fi、BT、媒体或AP SMP的服务。当前`bk7258_boot.c`中的`board_early_initialize()`和`board_app_initialize()`仍为空实现，本文列出的board app工作均未完成。

1280: ## 12. 实施步骤和验收
1281: 
1282: ### 阶段一：固化golden
1283:

1286: - CPU0 CP ELF/map/raw。

1294: ### 阶段二：CPU1按SPE基线启动
1295: 
1296: 实现：
1297: 
1298: - Secure hard-float toolchain。
1299: - Flash boot vector。
1300: - RAM runtime vector。
1301: - C runtime。
1302: - MPU。
1303: - FPU。
1304: - Mailbox early log transport，由CP UART0输出。
1305:

1307: 
1308: - CPU1能从当前目标项目生成的AP XIP origin取vector；基础`app_ab`才使用`0x02150000`。
1309: - MSP位于AP RAM。
1310: - VTOR最终位于RAM runtime vector。
1311: - 无HardFault、BusFault、MemManageFault或SecureFault。
1312: - 100次CPU1启动无随机失败。
1313: - 导出并对比golden/openvela的安全状态、SAU和PPC/MPC关键寄存器；在完成前只称“SPE功能基线”，不称“可信启动”。

1315: ### 阶段三：完整mailbox v2
1316:

1318: 
1319: - MBOX0 FIFO。
1320: - CPU1 endpoint。
1321: - NVIC外部line63、NuttX IRQ79和32-63 gate。
1322: - 共享buffer pointer/length。
1323: - logical channel、sequence、ACK、reset。
1324: - PWC transport。

1328:

1330: 
1331: - CPU0/CPU1连续完成10000次command/ACK。
1332: - 无FIFO full、busy泄漏、sequence错乱和共享buffer覆盖。

1350: 
1351: - ready P99小于200 ms。
1352: - CP不发生启动重试。

1356: ### 阶段五：Mailbox UART日志转发和NSH
1357: 
1358: 实现并验收AP到CP的Mailbox UART日志转发，启动NSH并通过CP UART0观察。当前已实现基础日志转发和NSH交互，完整压力验证和reset恢复仍有缺口：

1360: ```text

1363: uptime
1364: free
1365: ```

1375: 
1376: 完成：
1377:

1379: - CPU1 PSRAM状态机。
1380: - 独立PSRAM allocator启用、冻结和拒绝断电机制。
1381: - PSRAM使用量统计。
1382: - power-off前清退。
1383: - recovery和重新启动。
1384: 
1385: PSRAM在这一步仍保持non-cacheable。power-off时只在outstanding为0时确认，否则返回busy，不尝试注销通用heap。完成72小时压力、掉电恢复和AP recovery测试后，才评估I-cache/D-cache。

1399: ## 13. `bk_solution_ai`交叉验证和多项目布局
1400: 
1401: `bk_solution_ai`是依赖`bk_avdk_smp`的外置AI解决方案仓库，不包含BK7258 startup、mailbox底层、bootloader、packager或芯片基础静态库。它不能替代SMP SDK，但提供了正式产品项目的资源需求和构建边界。

290: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
291: {
292:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
293:   struct pwc_message message;
294:   unsigned int next;
295: 
296:   if (bytes == NULL)
297:     {
298:       return -EINVAL;
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
302:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
303:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
304: 
305:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
306:   if (next == g_tail)
307:     {
308:       return -EAGAIN;
309:     }
310: 
311:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
312:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
313:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
314:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
315:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
316:   g_head = next;
317:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
318:   return OK;
319: }

321: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
322: {
323:   int ret = OK;
324: 
325:   (void)argc;
326:   (void)argv;
327:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_ENTER);
328: 
329:   /* bk7258_mailbox_workers_start() pinned the bring-up thread to CPU0.
330:    * Kernel threads inherit that affinity before activation, so changing the
331:    * running PWC worker's affinity here is redundant and can trigger another
332:    * SMP scheduler transaction during the boot handshake. */
333: 
334:   g_worker_result = OK;
335:   g_worker_ready = true;
336:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_READY);
337:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
338: 
339:   for (;;)
340:     {
341:       struct pwc_message message;
342:       irqstate_t flags;
343: 
344:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
345:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
346:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
347:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
348:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
350:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
351:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
352: 
353:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
354:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
355:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
356:         {
357:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
358:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
359:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
360:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
361:               {
362:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
363:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
364:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
365:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
366:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
367:               }
368:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
369:             break;
370: 
371:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
372:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
373:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
374:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
375:               {
376:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
377:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
378:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
379:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
380:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
381:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
382:               }
383:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:             break;
385: 
386: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
387:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
388:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
389:               {
390:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
391:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
392:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
393:                 if (ret != OK)
394:                   {
395:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
396:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
397:                   }
398:               }
399:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
400:               {
401:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
402: 
403:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
404:               }
405:             break;
406: 
407:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
408:             bk7258_psram_dump();
409:             break;
410: 
411:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
412:             {
413: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
414:               ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,
415:                                   PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
416:                                   (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
417: #else
418:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
419: 
420:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
421:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
422:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
423:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
424: #endif
425:               if (ret != OK)
426:                 {
427:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
428:                 }
429:             }
430:             break;
431: #endif
432: 
433:           default:
434:             break;
435:         }
436:     }
437:   return 0;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Armino-compatible HW_CTRL power-up and heartbeat service.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: #include <syslog.h>
13: 
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
18: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
19: 
20: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
21: #define IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION   1u
22: #define IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION 2u
23: #define IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE         2u
24: #define IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS        600u
25: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL         MSEC2TICK(2000)
26: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY            MSEC2TICK(100)
27: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US           10000u
28: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY          110
29: 
30: static mutex_t g_ipc_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
31: static volatile int g_ipc_ack_result;
32: static volatile int g_ipc_start_result;
33: static volatile int g_heartbeat_result;
34: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_enabled;
35: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_pending;
36: static volatile uint32_t g_heartbeat_completions;
37: static clock_t g_next_heartbeat;
38: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_failures;
39: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_submissions;
40: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_reported;
41: static bool g_ipc_started;
42: 
43: static int bind_worker_to_primary(void)
44: {
45: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
46:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
47: 
48:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
49:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
50:   return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
51: #else
52:   return OK;
53: #endif
54: }
55: 
56: static int ipc_ack_result(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
57:                           int result)
58: {
59:   if (result == OK &&
60:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))
61:     {
62:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
63:     }
64: 
65:   return result;
66: }
67: 
68: static void ipc_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
69:                               int result, void *arg)
70: {
71:   g_ipc_ack_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
72:   if ((uintptr_t)arg == IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION &&
73:       g_ipc_ack_result == OK)
74:     {
75:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
76:       g_next_heartbeat = clock_systime_ticks() + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
77:       g_heartbeat_enabled = true;
78:     }
79: }
80: 
81: static void ipc_heartbeat_complete(
82:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
83: {
84:   (void)arg;
85:   g_heartbeat_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
86:   g_heartbeat_completions++;
87:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
88: }
89: 
90: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
91: {
92:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
93:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
94:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
95:   int ret;
96: 
97:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
98:   if (ret < 0)
99:     {
100:       return ret;
101:     }
102: 
103:   *payload = parameter;
104:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
105: 
106:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
107:   message.header = command;
108:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
109:   message.payload_length =
110:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
111:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
112: 
113:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
114:                                   ipc_tx_complete,
115:                                   (void *)(uintptr_t)command);
116:   if (ret == OK)
117:     {
118:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
119:       if (ret == OK)
120:         {
121:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
126:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
127: }
128: 
129: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
130: {
131:   int ret;
132: 
133:   (void)argc;
134:   (void)argv;
135: 
136:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
137:   if (ret < 0)
138:     {
139:       return -EXDEV;
140:     }
141: 
142:   for (;;)
143:     {
144:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US);
145:       bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll();
146:     }
147: 
148:   return OK;
149: }
150: 
151: void bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll(void)
152: {
153:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
154:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
155:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
156:   clock_t now;
157:   int ret;
158: 
159:   if (!g_heartbeat_enabled || g_heartbeat_pending)
160:     {
161:       return;
162:     }
163: 
164:   if (g_heartbeat_completions != g_heartbeat_reported)
165:     {
166:       g_heartbeat_reported = g_heartbeat_completions;
167:       if (g_heartbeat_reported <= 3u)
168:         {
169:           printf("IPC: heartbeat ACK result=%d count=%lu\n",
170:                  g_heartbeat_result,
171:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_reported);
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
176:     {
177:       g_heartbeat_failures++;
178:       if ((g_heartbeat_failures & (g_heartbeat_failures - 1u)) == 0)
179:         {
180:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat failed: %d count=%lu\n",
181:                  g_heartbeat_result,
182:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_failures);
183:         }
184: 
185:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
186:     }
187: 
188:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
189:   if ((sclock_t)(now - g_next_heartbeat) < 0)
190:     {
191:       return;
192:     }
193: 
194:   *payload = 0;
195:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
196:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
197:   message.header = IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION;
198:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
199:   message.payload_length = sizeof(*payload);
200:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
201:   g_heartbeat_pending = true;
202:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
203:                                  ipc_heartbeat_complete, NULL);
204:   if (ret == OK)
205:     {
206:       g_heartbeat_submissions++;
207:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
208:       if (g_heartbeat_submissions <= 3u)
209:         {
210:           printf("IPC: heartbeat queued count=%lu tick=%llu\n",
211:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_submissions,
212:                  (unsigned long long)now);
213:         }
214:     }
215:   else
216:     {
217:       g_heartbeat_pending = false;
218:       g_heartbeat_result = ret;
219:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY;
220:     }
221: }
222: 
223: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
224: {
225:   int pid;
226:   int ret;
227: 
228:   if (g_ipc_started)
229:     {
230:       return g_ipc_start_result;
231:     }
232: 
233:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
234:   g_heartbeat_enabled = false;
235:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
236:   g_heartbeat_completions = 0;
237:   g_heartbeat_failures = 0;
238:   g_heartbeat_submissions = 0;
239:   g_heartbeat_reported = 0;
240:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
241:   if (ret < 0)
242:     {
243:       g_ipc_start_result = -EXDEV;
244:     }
245:   else
246:     {
247:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION, 0);
248:       g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
249:     }
250: 
251:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
252:     {
253:       pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY, 1536,
254:                            ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
255:       if (pid < 0)
256:         {
257:           g_ipc_start_result = pid;
258:         }
259:     }
260: 
261:   g_ipc_started = g_ipc_start_result == OK;
262: 
263:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
264:     {
265:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP, heartbeat armed "
266:              "now=%llu deadline=%llu\n",
267:              (unsigned long long)clock_systime_ticks(),
268:              (unsigned long long)g_next_heartbeat);
269:     }
270: 
271:   return g_ipc_start_result;
272: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_timerisr.c
3:  *
4:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <nuttx/config.h>
8: 
9: #include <errno.h>
10: #include <stdbool.h>
11: #include <stdint.h>
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
16: 
17: #include <arch/arm_m/nvicpri.h>
18: 
19: #include "arm_internal.h"
20: #include "nvic.h"
21: #include "irq.h"
22: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
23: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
24: 
25: #define BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD \
26:   ((CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ / TICK_PER_SEC) - 1u)
27: 
28: #if CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ % TICK_PER_SEC != 0
29: #  error "BK7258 CPU frequency must divide evenly into the system tick rate"
30: #endif
31: 
32: #if BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD > NVIC_MAX_SYSTICK_CNT
33: #  error "BK7258 SysTick reload exceeds the 24-bit counter"
34: #endif
35: 
36: static bool g_first_tick_complete;
37: static uint32_t g_tick_count;
38: 
39: static int bk7258_timerisr(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
40: {
41:   uint32_t tick = ++g_tick_count;
42:   bool first_tick = !g_first_tick_complete;
43: 
44:   (void)irq;
45:   (void)context;
46:   (void)arg;
47: 
48:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, (tick << 8) | 1u);
49: 
50:   bk7258_smp_retry_pending();
51:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, (tick << 8) | 2u);
52:   nxsched_process_timer();
53:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, (tick << 8) | 3u);
54: 
55:   if (first_tick)
56:     {
57:       g_first_tick_complete = true;
58:     }
59: 
60:   return OK;
61: }
62: 
63: int bk7258_timer_start(void)
64: {
65:   if (up_cpu_index() != 0)
66:     {
67:       return -EXDEV;
68:     }
69: 
70:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
71:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_SYSTICK_STARTED);
72:   putreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_CLKSOURCE | NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_TICKINT |
73:            NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
74:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK);
75:   return OK;
76: }
77: 
78: void up_timer_initialize(void)
79: {
80:   uint32_t priority;
81: 
82:   /* Match the vendor SMP port's configTICK_CORE contract: only logical CPU0
83:    * owns the global tick.  CPU1 leaves its private SysTick disabled.
84:    */
85: 
86:   DEBUGASSERT(up_cpu_index() == 0);
87: 
88:   priority = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
89:   priority &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR15_MASK;
90:   priority |= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT <<
91:               NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR15_SHIFT;
92:   putreg32(priority, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
93: 
94:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
95:   putreg32(BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD, NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD);
96:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
97: 
98:   if (irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK, bk7258_timerisr, NULL) < 0)
99:     {
100:       PANIC();
101:     }
102: 
103:   /* nx_start() initializes the clock before nx_smp_start().  Keep SysTick
104:    * stopped until up_cpu_start() has completed the secondary boot transaction.
105:    */
106: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 CPU2 startup.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <errno.h>
9: #include <stdbool.h>
10: #include <stdint.h>
11: #include <syslog.h>
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
14: #include <nuttx/atomic.h>
15: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
16: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
17: #include <nuttx/sched_note.h>
18: 
19: #include "arm_internal.h"
20: #include "dwt.h"
21: #include "init/init.h"
22: #include "nvic.h"
23: #include "sched/sched.h"
24: #include "hardware/bk7258_memorymap.h"
25: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
26: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
27: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
28: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
29: 
30: #if CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS != 2
31: #  error "BK7258 OpenVela SMP supports exactly two AP CPUs"
32: #endif
33: 
34: #if CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ != 480000000
35: #  error "BK7258 OpenVela SMP requires the fixed 480 MHz CP contract"
36: #endif
37: 
38: #define BK7258_CPU2_ONLINE_CYCLES  (CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ / 2u)
39: #define BK7258_CPU2_POLL_LIMIT     4000000u
40: 
41: extern uint8_t __secondary_vectors_start[];
42: extern uint8_t __secondary_boot_stack_base[];
43: 
44: static void bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset(void)
45: {
46:   putreg32(getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL) & ~BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE,
47:            BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
48:   UP_DSB();
49: }
50: 
51: static void bk7258_cpu2_release_reset(void)
52: {
53:   putreg32(getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL) | BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE,
54:            BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
55:   UP_DSB();
56:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");
57: }
58: 
59: static void __attribute__((used, noreturn)) bk7258_secondary_idle(void)
60: {
61:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IDLE);
62:   arm_initialize_stack();
63:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_STACK);
64:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ONLINE);
65:   bk7258_smp_boot_notify();
66:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_NOTIFY);
67:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IRQ_ON);
68:   up_irq_enable();
69:   sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
70:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_SCHED);
71: 
72:   while (!bk7258_smp_boot_ping_received())
73:     {
74:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
75:     }
76: 
77:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_WAIT);
78:   bk7258_smp_boot_ack();
79:   bk7258_smp_secondary_ready();
80:   nx_idle_trampoline();
81:   PANIC();
82: }
83: 
84: static void __attribute__((naked, noreturn))
85: bk7258_secondary_enter(uintptr_t idle_top __attribute__((unused)),
86:                        uintptr_t idle_base __attribute__((unused)))
87: {
88:   __asm__ volatile
89:     (
90:       "msr psp, r0\n"
91: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
92:       "msr psplim, r1\n"
93: #endif
94:       "mrs r1, control\n"
95:       "orr r1, r1, #2\n"
96:       "msr control, r1\n"
97:       "isb sy\n"
98:       "b bk7258_secondary_idle\n"
99:     );
100: }
101: 
102: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
103:                            target("general-regs-only")))
104: bk7258_secondary_boot(void)
105: {
106:   struct tcb_s *tcb;
107:   uintptr_t idle_top;
108: 
109:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ENTRY);
110:   bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(false);
111:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_PRIVATE);
112:   bk7258_irqinitialize_secondary();
113:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IRQ);
114:   if (bk7258_mbox_secondary_init() < 0)
115:     {
116:       PANIC();
117:     }
118: 
119:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX);
120: 
121:   tcb = current_task(1);
122:   idle_top = ((uintptr_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr + tcb->adj_stack_size) & ~7u;
123:   bk7258_secondary_enter(idle_top, (uintptr_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr);
124: }
125: 
126: void __attribute__((naked, noreturn, section(".start_text")))
127: bk7258_secondary_start(void)
128: {
129:   __asm__ volatile
130:     (

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
19: #include "irq.h"
20: 
21: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
22: #define MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET   8u
23: 
24: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
25: {
26:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
27:   uint32_t order;
28:   bool used;
29: };
30: 
31: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
32: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
33: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
34: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
35: static bool g_mbox_ready;
36: static bool g_mbox_smp_ready;
37: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
38: 
39: static void mbox_trace_errors(void)
40: {
41:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(4,
42:     (g_stats.bad_source & 0xffu) |
43:     ((g_stats.bad_length & 0xffu) << 8) |
44:     ((g_stats.bad_address & 0xffu) << 16) |
45:     ((g_stats.descriptor_full & 0xffu) << 24));
46: }
47: 
48: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
49:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
50: 
51: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
52: {
53:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
54:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);
55: }
56: 
57: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
58: {
59:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
60:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
61:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
62: 
63:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
64:     {
65:       g_stats.write_error++;
66:     }
67: 
68:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
69:     {
70:       g_stats.read_error++;
71:     }
72: 
73:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
74:     {
75:       g_stats.write_full++;
76:     }
77: 
78:   if (errors != 0)
79:     {
80:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
81:     }
82: }
83: 
84: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
85:                                 uint32_t length)
86: {
87:   if (source != 0)
88:     {
89:       g_stats.bad_source++;
90:       mbox_trace_errors();
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_length++;
97:       mbox_trace_errors();
98:       return false;
99:     }
100: 
101:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
102:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       g_stats.bad_address++;
105:       mbox_trace_errors();
106:       return false;
107:     }
108: 
109:   return true;
110: }
111: 
112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   irqstate_t flags;
115:   uintptr_t status;
116:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
117: 
118:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
119:     {
120:       return -EINVAL;
121:     }
122: 
123: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
124:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
125:     {
126:       return -EPERM;
127:     }
128: #endif
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
136:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
137:   flags = up_irq_save();
138:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
139:     {
140:       up_irq_restore(flags);
141:       return -EAGAIN;
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* TDATA0/TDATA1 are staging registers and TID commits the descriptor.
145:    * Keep raw SMP kicks and transport sends from interleaving these writes.
146:    */
147: 
148:   putreg32(data[0], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 :
149:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
150:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
151:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
152:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
153:                                    BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
154:   up_irq_restore(flags);
155:   return OK;
156: }
157: 
158: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
159: {
160:   unsigned int i;
161: 
162:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
163:     {
164:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
165:         {
166:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
167:         }
168:     }
169: 
170:   return NULL;
171: }
172: 
173: static bool mbox_priority_message(
174:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
175: {
176:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
177: 
178:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
179: }
180: 
181: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
182: {
183:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
184:   unsigned int i;
185: 
186:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
187:     {
188:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
189: 
190:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
191:         {
192:           continue;
193:         }
194: 
195:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
196:         {
197:           oldest = desc;
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:   return oldest;
202: }
203: 
204: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
205: {
206:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
207:   int ret;
208: 
209:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
210:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
211:    */
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
216:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
217:       g_processing_order = 0;
218:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
219:         {
220:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
221:           break;
222:         }
223: 
224:       desc->used = false;
225:     }
226: 
227:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
228:     {
229:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
230:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
231:       g_processing_order = 0;
232:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
233:         {
234:           break;
235:         }
236: 
237:       desc->used = false;
238:     }
239: }
240: 
241: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
242: {
243:   uintptr_t rdata0;
244:   uintptr_t rdata1;
245:   uintptr_t sidreg;
246:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
247:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
248: 
249:   (void)irq;
250:   (void)context;
251:   (void)arg;
252: 
253:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
254:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
255:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
256:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
257:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
258:     {
259:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
260:     }
261:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
262:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
263:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
264: 
265:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
266:     {
267:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
268:       uint32_t address;
269:       uint32_t length;
270:       uint8_t source;
271: 
272:       if (cpu == 0)
273:         {
274:           mbox_process_desc();
275:         }
276: 
277:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
278:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
279:         {
280:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
281:           mbox_trace_errors();
282:           break;
283:         }
284: 
285:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
286:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
287:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
288: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
289:       if (length == 0)
290:         {
291:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
292:             {
293:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
294:                 {
295:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
296:                 }
297: 
298:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
299:             }
300:           else
301:             {
302:               if (cpu == 0)
303:                 {
304:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
305:                   mbox_trace_errors();
306:                 }
307:             }
308: 
309:           continue;
310:         }
311: #endif
312: 
313:       if (cpu != 0)
314:         {
315:           continue;
316:         }
317: 
318:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
319:         {
320:           continue;
321:         }
322: 
323:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
324:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
325:              sizeof(desc->message));
326:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
327:       desc->used = true;
328:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
329:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
330:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);

205:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
206:         {
207:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
208:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
209:            */
210: 
211:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
212:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
214:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
215:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
216:         }
217:       else
218:         {
219:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
220:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
221:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
222:             {
223:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
224:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
225:                */
226: 
227:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
228:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
229:             }
230:           else
231:             {
232:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
233:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
234:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
235:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
236:             }
237:         }
238: 
239:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
240:     }
241:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
242:     {
243:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
244:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
245:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
246:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
247:        */
248: 
249:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
250:     }
251: 
252:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
253:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
254: }

256: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
257:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
258: {
259:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
260:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
261:   uint16_t first;
262:   bool failed = false;
263:   bool malformed = false;
264: 
265:   (void)arg;
266:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
267:     {
268:       return -EINVAL;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
272:     {
273:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
274:       failed = true;
275:       malformed = true;
276:     }
277:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
278:     {
279:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
280:       failed = true;
281:       malformed = true;
282:     }
283:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
284:     {
285:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
286:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
287:       failed = true;
288:       malformed = true;
289:     }
290:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
291:     {
292:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
293:       failed = true;
294:       malformed = true;
295:     }
296: 
297:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
298:     {
299:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
300:         {
301:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
302:           failed = true;
303:           malformed = true;
304:         }
305:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
306:         {
307:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
308:           failed = true;
309:           malformed = true;
310:         }
311:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
312:         {
313:           failed = true;
314:         }
315:       else if (rx_free() < length)
316:         {
317:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
318:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
319:           failed = true;
320:         }
321:       else
322:         {
323:           const uint8_t *source =
324:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
325: 
326:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
327:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
328:           if (first > length)
329:             {
330:               first = length;
331:             }
332: 
333:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
334:           if (first != length)
335:             {
336:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
337:             }
338: 
339:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
340:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
341:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
342:         }
343:     }
344:   else if (!failed)
345:     {
346:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
347:         {
348:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
349:           failed = true;
350:           malformed = true;
351:         }
352:       else
353:         {
354:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (!malformed)
359:     {
360:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
361: 
362:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
363:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
364:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
365:         {
366:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
367:         }
368:     }
369: 
370:   update_local_rts();
371:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
372:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
373:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
374: }

427:     }

429:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
430:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
431:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
432:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
433:   message.payload_length = length;
434:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
435:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
436:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
437:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
438:   if (ret == OK)
439:     {

441:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;

449: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
450: {
451:   int ret;
452: 
453:   (void)argc;
454:   (void)argv;
455:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
456:   if (ret < 0)
457:     {
458:       return -EXDEV;
459:     }
460: 
461:   for (;;)
462:     {
463:       bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
464:       void *callback_arg;
465:       irqstate_t flags;
466: 
467:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
468:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
469:       nxsem_reset(&g_uart.worker_sem, 0);
470:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
471: 
472:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)
473:         {
474:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
475: 
476:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
477:             {
478:               (void)send_state_locked();
479:             }
480:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
481:             {
482:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
483:                 {
484:                   (void)send_state_locked();
485:                 }
486:               else
487:                 {
488:                   (void)send_data_locked();
489:                 }
490:             }
491:         }
492: 
493:       callback = g_uart.callback;
494:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;
495:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
496: 
497:       if (callback != NULL)
498:         {
499:           callback(callback_arg);
500:         }
501:     }
502: 
503:   return OK;
504: }

48: /****************************************************************************
49:  * Name: nxthread_create
50:  *
51:  * Description:
52:  *   This function creates and activates a new thread of the specified type
53:  *   with a specified priority and returns its system-assigned ID.  It is the
54:  *   internal, common implementation of task_create() and kthread_create().
55:  *   See comments with task_create() for further information.
56:  *
57:  * Input Parameters:
58:  *   name       - Name of the new task
59:  *   ttype      - Type of the new task
60:  *   priority   - Priority of the new task
61:  *   stack_addr - Address of the stack needed
62:  *   stack_size - Size (in bytes) of the stack needed
63:  *   entry      - Entry point of a new task
64:  *   arg        - A pointer to an array of input parameters.  The array
65:  *                should be terminated with a NULL argv[] value. If no
66:  *                parameters are required, argv may be NULL.
67:  *   envp       - A pointer to an array of environment strings. Terminated
68:  *                with a NULL entry.
69:  *
70:  * Returned Value:
71:  *   Returns the positive, non-zero process ID of the new task or a negated
72:  *   errno value to indicate the nature of any failure.  If memory is
73:  *   insufficient or the task cannot be created -ENOMEM will be returned.
74:  *
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: int nxthread_create(FAR const char *name, int ttype, int priority,
78:                     FAR void *stack_addr, int stack_size, main_t entry,
79:                     FAR char * const argv[], FAR char * const envp[])
80: {
81:   posix_spawnattr_t attr;
82:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb;
83:   pid_t pid;
84:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
85: 
86:   posix_spawnattr_init(&attr);
87:   posix_spawnattr_setstacksize(&attr, (size_t)stack_size);
88:   posix_spawnattr_setstackaddr(&attr, stack_addr);
89:   posix_spawnattr_setpriority(&attr, priority);
90: 
91:   /* Allocate a TCB for the new task. */
92: 
93:   tcb = kmm_zalloc(ttype == TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL ?
94:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) :
95:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) + sizeof(struct task_group_s));
96:   if (!tcb)
97:     {
98:       serr("ERROR: Failed to allocate TCB\n");
99:     }
100:   else
101:     {
102:       /* Setup the task type */
103: 
104:       atomic_set(&tcb->flags, ttype | TCB_FLAG_FREE_TCB);
105: 
106:       /* Initialize the task */
107: 
108:       ret = nxtask_init(tcb, name, entry, NULL, &attr, argv, envp);
109:       posix_spawnattr_destroy(&attr);
110:       if (ret < OK)
111:         {
112:           kmm_free(tcb);
113:         }
114:       else
115:         {
116:           /* Get the assigned pid before we start the task */
117: 
118:           pid = tcb->pid;
119: 
120:           /* Activate the task */
121: 
122:           nxtask_activate(tcb);
123: 
124:           ret = pid;
125:         }
126:     }
127: 
128:   return ret;
129: }

131: /****************************************************************************
132:  * Name: nxtask_create
133:  *
134:  * Description:
135:  *   This function creates and activates a new task with a specified
136:  *   priority and returns its system-assigned ID.
137:  *
138:  *   The entry address entry is the address of the "main" function of the
139:  *   task.  This function will be called once the C environment has been
140:  *   set up.  The specified function will be called with four arguments.
141:  *   Should the specified routine return, a call to exit() will
142:  *   automatically be made.
143:  *
144:  *   Note that four (and only four) arguments must be passed for the spawned
145:  *   functions.
146:  *
147:  *   nxtask_create() is identical to the function task_create(), differing
148:  *   only in its return value:  This function does not modify the errno
149:  *   variable.  This is a non-standard, internal OS function and is not
150:  *   intended for use by application logic.  Applications should use
151:  *   task_create().
152:  *
153:  * Input Parameters:
154:  *   name       - Name of the new task
155:  *   priority   - Priority of the new task
156:  *   stack_addr - Address of the stack needed
157:  *   stack_size - Size (in bytes) of the stack needed
158:  *   entry      - Entry point of a new task
159:  *   arg        - A pointer to an array of input parameters.  The array
160:  *                should be terminated with a NULL argv[] value. If no
161:  *                parameters are required, argv may be NULL.
162:  *   envp       - A pointer to an array of environment strings. Terminated
163:  *                with a NULL entry.
164:  *
165:  * Returned Value:
166:  *   Returns the positive, non-zero process ID of the new task or a negated
167:  *   errno value to indicate the nature of any failure.  If memory is
168:  *   insufficient or the task cannot be created -ENOMEM will be returned.
169:  *
170:  ****************************************************************************/
171: 
172: int nxtask_create(FAR const char *name, int priority,
173:                   FAR void *stack_addr, int stack_size, main_t entry,
174:                   FAR char * const argv[], FAR char * const envp[])
175: {
176:   return nxthread_create(name, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_TASK, priority, stack_addr,
177:                          stack_size, entry, argv, envp ? envp : environ);
178: }

180: /****************************************************************************
181:  * Name: task_create
182:  *
183:  * Description:
184:  *   This function creates and activates a new task with a specified
185:  *   priority and returns its system-assigned ID.

187:  *   The entry address entry is the address of the "main" function of the
188:  *   task.  This function will be called once the C environment has been
189:  *   set up.  The specified function will be called with four arguments.

199:  *   stack_size - size (in bytes) of the stack needed
200:  *   entry      - Entry point of a new task

202:  *                should be terminated with a NULL argv[] value. If no
203:  *                parameters are required, argv may be NULL.
204:  *
205:  * Returned Value:
206:  *   Returns the non-zero process ID of the new task or ERROR if memory is
207:  *   insufficient or the task cannot be created.  The errno will be set in
208:  *   the failure case to indicate the nature of the error.
209:  *
